integrity: All finite probabilities and power formulae are derived exactly; independent audit and exhaustive priority review have not been performed. No empirical samples or external certifications were used.
scientific_limitations: Two independent equally parameterized games, at least four objects, match-count observations and the first nontrivial total-two significance band; no statement about more games, other levels, or heterogeneity.
title: Exact first-tie power gap for two generalized matching games
